JOB_NAME.comment: The name of a job, defined in the `job_name` var or in the `JOB_NAME` env var.

JOB_RUN_ID.comment: The run ID of a job, defined in the `job_run_id` var or in the `DBT_JOB_RUN_ID` env var or by the orchestrator (dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc).

GENERATED_AT.name: GENERATED_AT
GENERATED_AT.comment: The time this invocation was uploaded to the database.

COMMAND.name: COMMAND
COMMAND.comment: dbt command that was used. For example, run.

DBT_VERSION.name: DBT_VERSION
DBT_VERSION.comment: Version of dbt that was used in this invocation.

ELEMENTARY_VERSION.name: ELEMENTARY_VERSION
ELEMENTARY_VERSION.comment: Version of the elementary package that was used in this invocation.

FULL_REFRESH.name: FULL_REFRESH
FULL_REFRESH.comment: Whether or not this invocation was executed as a full-refresh.

INVOCATION_VARS.name: INVOCATION_VARS
INVOCATION_VARS.comment: Dictionary of the variables (and values) that were declared in the invocation.

VARS.name: VARS
VARS.comment: Dictionary of all variables (and values) in the dbt project. If none were declared at runtime, these are the variables declared in dbt_project yml

TARGET_NAME.name: TARGET_NAME
TARGET_NAME.comment: Name of the target used in this invocation.

TARGET_DATABASE.name: TARGET_DATABASE
TARGET_DATABASE.comment: Name of the target database that was used in this invocation.

TARGET_SCHEMA.name: TARGET_SCHEMA
TARGET_SCHEMA.comment: Name of the target schema that was used in this invocation.

TARGET_PROFILE_NAME.name: TARGET_PROFILE_NAME
TARGET_PROFILE_NAME.comment: Name of the dbt profile that was used in this invocation.

THREADS.name: THREADS
THREADS.comment: Number of threads that were used to run this dbt invocation. (This number could impact the performance of a dbt invocation).

SELECTED.name: SELECTED
SELECTED.comment: The selected resources in the dbt command. While this is a string in the database, this can easily be converted to an array.

YAML_SELECTOR.name: YAML_SELECTOR
YAML_SELECTOR.comment: The yaml selector that was passed in this invocation.

PROJECT_ID.name: PROJECT_ID
PROJECT_ID.comment: The ID of a project, defined in the `DBT_PROJECT_ID` env var or by the orchestrator (dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc).

ENV.name: ENV
ENV.comment: The environment's name, defined in the `DBT_ENV` env var.

ENV_ID.name: ENV_ID
ENV_ID.comment: The ID of an environment, defined in the `DBT_ENV_ID` env var.

CAUSE_CATEGORY.name: CAUSE_CATEGORY
CAUSE_CATEGORY.comment:
The category of the cause of the invocation. For example, if the invocation was triggered by a schedule, the cause category would be schedule.
Defined in the `DBT_CAUSE_CATEGORY` env var or by the orchestrator (dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc).

CAUSE.name: CAUSE
CAUSE.comment:
The cause of the invocation. For example, if the invocation was triggered by a manual run, the cause would be _"Kicked off by Joe."_.
Defined in the `DBT_CAUSE` env var or by the orchestrator (dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc).

PULL_REQUEST_ID.name: PULL_REQUEST_ID
PULL_REQUEST_ID.comment: The ID of a pull request, defined in the `DBT_PULL_REQUEST_ID` env var or by the orchestrator (dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc).

GIT_SHA.name: GIT_SHA
GIT_SHA.comment: The git SHA of the commit that was used in this invocation, defined in the `DBT_GIT_SHA` env var or by the orchestrator (dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc).

ORCHESTRATOR.name: ORCHESTRATOR
ORCHESTRATOR.comment: The orchestrator that was used to run this invocation, defined in the `orchestrator` var or in the `ORCHESTRATOR` env var or by the orchestrator env vars. For example, dbt Cloud, GitHub Actions, etc.

JOB_URL.name: JOB_URL
JOB_URL.comment: The name of a job, defined in the `job_url` var or in the `JOB_URL` env var or by the orchestrator. For GitHub Actions orchestrator, the value is calculated.

ACCOUNT_ID.name: ACCOUNT_ID
ACCOUNT_ID.comment: The ID of the account, defined in the `account_id` var or in the `ACCOUNT_ID` env var or by the orchestrator.
